dos.text: Distinguish the two real shapes UrlbarView.mjs actually creates: a plain .urlbarView-action label span for inline text (e.g. "Search with Google"), versus a .urlbarView-action-btn for a real secondary action (switch-to-tab, pin, dismiss) built via #createSecondaryAction.

donts.text: Don't confuse this with the row itself, a urlbar-action is a sub-element inside a urlbar-result row, not the row.
